data.text:
Rahul Saw @ Shiv Lochan Saha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 
26 February, 2024 
Author: Rajesh Kumar
Bench: Rajesh Kumar
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 W.P.(Cr). No.201 of 2023
 ----
Rahul Saw @ Shiv Lochan Saha .... .... Petitioner Versus
1. The State of Jharkhand
2. Superintendent of Police, P.O. & P.S. Sakchi, East Singhbhum
3. Food Safety Commissioner, Jharkhand
4. Designated Officer-cum-Sub Divisional Officer, Dalbhum
5. Food Safety Officer, East Singhbhum
6. Officer-in-Charge, Bagbera Police Station, East Singhbhum .... .... Respondents 
---- 
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Zaid Imam, Adv. For the Respondents : Mr. Devesh Krishna, Adv.
----
th 06/Dated: 26 February, 2024 1. Heard the parties. 
2. The present writ criminal petition has been filed for following reliefs:-
"For quashing the entire criminal proceedings and also the First Information Report in connection with Bagbera P.S. Case No.45 of 203 dated 28.03.2023 lodged under Rahul Saw @ Shiv Lochan Saha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 26 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175621143/
1 Sections 272, 273, 420, 465, 467, 468, 469, 471 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, which is pending in the court of Sri Aditya, Learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class,
Jamshedpur, East Singhbhum." 
3. After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present writ criminal petition with a liberty to raise all the plea at the time of framing of charge. 
4. Permission is granted. 
5. With the above observation and direction, the present criminal writ petition is hereby, disposed of. 
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Raja/-
